question: can RGB-PSNR be the quality axis for a BD-rate against a yuv420p codec?

measured.arm: av1 coding the source, preset 10, QP, yuv420p, via coded_roundtrip
measured.reading: A 2.9x change in rate moved RGB-PSNR by 0.46 dB. The arm is capped by the RGB->yuv420p->RGB chroma round-trip, not by the quantizer. The 3 dB absolute-span guard in bd_rate refuses this curve, correctly.

why_it_also_breaks_the_comparison: The cap is asymmetric. PointStream delivers a JPEG plate with source crops pasted over it, so most of its pixels never make the 4:2:0 round-trip. On the same clip its delivered RGB-PSNR was 42.0-42.6 dB, above a ceiling the anchor cannot reach at any QP, so the two curves have no overlapping quality range at all. A BD-rate taken there would be measuring the colour format.
what_the_ladder_does_instead: BD-rate is taken on BT.601 Y-PSNR, which is what the BD-rate literature reports. RGB-PSNR is recorded per rung so the chroma cost stays visible rather than being quietly dropped.
provenance: Measured 2026-08-28 during the first full ladder run, which was stopped at this point and restarted on the luma axis. These three points are the whole of that run.

superseded_diagnosis.what_this_file_originally_concluded: That the anchor's flat curve was caused by the RGB -> yuv420p -> RGB chroma round-trip.
superseded_diagnosis.why_that_was_wrong: Switching the axis to Y-PSNR barely moved the ceiling: 40.72 dB at QP 15 in RGB became 41.71 dB in luma, and the curve stayed flat at the fine end (41.71 at QP 15 against 41.67 at QP 25). A chroma explanation predicts the ceiling lifts when chroma leaves the metric. It did not, so the cap was elsewhere. See plans/BP24-findings.md §14: the decode step named no -c:v and ffmpeg re-encoded to Matroska with libx264 at its default CRF, so every frame coded_roundtrip returned had been through a second encoder.
superseded_diagnosis.what_survives: The measurements themselves, and the decision to take BD-rate on Y-PSNR — that is the conventional axis regardless. What does not survive is the stated reason for it.
